programs.description: The host sheds light on some of the latest news stories, updates and developments pertaining to the entertainment industry.
The host shares a comprehensive compilation of various positive news updates that aim to spread positivity and cheer the viewers up.

A subject-matter expert delivers a detailed explanation and provides information on yoga in an easy-to-understand manner.
The host presents information about the social, economic and political issues of the day and provides updates on current events.
An expert healthcare professional provides insights for healthy lifestyle while shedding light on various ailments and their remedies.
